Review Text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ “An unforgettable experience! The towering cliffs, crystal-clear plunge pool, and sheer scale of Jim Jim Falls make it one of Kakadu’s most breathtaking spots.”

Such a majestic place! The 50km dirtroad is corrugated but not too bad as Gunlom right now. The last 10km is a 4WD track where you go through creeks, that last part took us 45min. because we are heavy loaded. Really worth it!
Breathtaking view. Only safe during dry season. Defiantly need a 4WD to acccess it.
Beautiful.
Amazing natural scenes. We went as part of a tour, arriving early. When we left (early afternoon) the car park was full. …
Absolutely spectacular. I can recommend coming in April at the end of the wet season when the weather is great and the falls are flowing.

Located in the heart of Kakadu National Park, this waterfall is a hidden gem. Getting there is an adventure in itself (4x4 required), but the reward is a natural pool surrounded by impressive cliffs. A total immersion in the wilderness!

Went to the falls in the last week of September. Absolutely stunning-the high cliffs and deep plunge pool are worth the drive in for sure. The road was fantastic as graders had just gone through. Two ankle high areas of water in the last 5 …
Great spot. Walk is definitely a challenge (about an hour each way) due to the amount of boulders but it was shaded and the swim is worth it. 4WD only to get to the car park

Thanks Audrey Senior for your review - it certainly helped us today. The road today had a lot of very deep corrugations and rocky ridges through the road. The good news is the graders are there so the road was already in better …

We went ou early around 9 am and walked back around 11 am which was perfect. We had the plunge pool all for ourselves. The waterfall didn't carry water but it's still stunning and absolutely worth the trip.

Worth the big drive in (50km of fairly rough then 7km of very rough). Bit of a boulder climb to the falls but stunning walk. Falls has a beach area. Good for swimming. Didn’t see anyone get eaten by crocs.
Nice walk in until you get to the rocks then you have to rock hop to the plunge pool. Went around 3pm after the tour buses left.

Loved Jim Jim Falls. The road was pretty rough before getting to the 4wd section. Heaps of people travelling way over 100k/hr leaving us with a cracked windscreen. The walk to the falls is so pretty but over huge boulders. Worth it though. Absolutely stunning.

Drove out to Jim Jim Falls today. Audrey's review is spot on, can't top that! I would say drive to conditions the road was a bit more chopped up. Easily accessed in 200 Series Landcruiser with AT's at highway pressures. Easy done.
Unsealed road was excellent, had almost zero corrugations - travel time approx 60 mins. …
The Tindal Air pilot did a turn over the falls, so I could get some photos on the way to Jabiru. My photography may leave something to be desired 🤣 …
Wonderful place. An incredible view from the valley or from the top of the plain.
Beautiful mountains wonderful style
Excellent service
It's definitely a beautiful place, but I stopped walking because there are clear warnings about crocodiles. …
Very beautiful place to enjoy nature. There is a short 1 hour hike which can be done from the parking.
Absolutely worth the trip. The drive is bumpy and seems to be never ending. Must have a 4wd. The walk in is quite simple. The water is not too cold.

Absolutely amazing views. The swimming at the plunge pool was the best place I have ever swam at by a mile. So natural. No rubbish anywhere. Natural 4x4 drive to get to the car parking. Pretty easy walk to get in
Nice fall should have try to get here
No water flowing but still amazing
This was a good one. It was a challenging walk over uneven rocks and climbing boulders, but the falls where worth it. Highly recommend it for a different type of walk
Even if you’re going in the dry season and there is little to no flowing falls, it’s worth the visit. Extremely impressive place and a very fresh swim! There’s a small beach spot too. …

There isn't any water over the falls at the moment... it's been a dry season. The last 50 or so metres is hard going for oldies. I bummed around a lot of boulders, but it was worth the effort. From the Caravan Park you need a 4x4.
Beautiful its magic

Headed of at 6.30am to arrive there in the cool of the day. Today was 37 degree Celsius. Fantastic work over ancient rocks. Make sure you wear good walking shoes. Some parts of the walk in are challenging but well worth it. When you arrive …
Great place to visit and swim if you can. All part of a 3 day tour of the forest back in 1999
Absolutely beautiful. Extremely difficult walk in. Well worth it. Not to be missed.

A beach in the middle of Kakadu National Park? Yes, there is. You can find this beauty at the bottom of Jim Jim Falls. 👣⛱ Beautiful place and must visit place for nature loving people. You will never get bored of it. …

From Garnamarr Campground, you have to do a 30 minutes off-roading to reach at the car park of Jim Jim Falls. From here there’s 55 minutes one way hiking to get to the falls, viewing pool and small beach. The way is a bit tough specially …

During the peak of the wet, we took a chartered plane across Kakadu. It was the best decision as the falls were a deluge! The spray from the falls created a rainbow as the sun hit the water particles - it was a phenomenal sight!
